sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.79 Dev

  • Masonry: Masonry has been corrected again to use a direct natural-proportion column flow, avoiding square-grid fallback, empty guide columns, and non-scrollable panels.
  • Modules: Disabled Admin/Builder modules are now saved, rebroadcast, and closed/refused across shortcuts, speed dial, global toggles, Mimam’s Bar, and builder media selection.
  • Media Library: The opt-in native Media Library replacement now embeds MV Media Studio inside the normal Media → Library page content instead of behaving like a popup overlay.
  • Long images: Fit width, Actual size, and Pan/zoom now use the full image surface from the real top-left so tall screenshots can be reached and panned.
  • Dragging: The working drag-selected-media-to-collection path is preserved while internal media drags remain separated from upload drop overlays.

v1.3.78 Dev

  • Masonry: Masonry now uses true natural-proportion column flow instead of square-grid sizing or empty guide columns.
  • Modules: Per-surface disabled modules now close/refuse entry from shortcuts, speed dial, global toggles, Mimam’s Bar, and builder media selection.
  • Media Library: The native Media Library replacement is rendered as embedded page content instead of a fixed overlay-style studio.
  • Dragging: Dragging selected media into an MV collection now uses the media payload/fallback and no longer triggers the upload overlay.
  • Long images: Fit width, Actual size, and Pan/zoom now anchor to the real top-left image surface.

v1.3.77 Dev

  • Masonry: Masonry view now avoids square-grid card assumptions so image cards can use their natural proportions.
  • Modules: Disabled modules now read the latest per-surface Admin/Builder settings across shortcuts, speed dial, global events, Mimam’s Bar, and builder media-picker paths.
  • Media Library: The opt-in native Media Library replacement now embeds Media Studio as the actual Media → Library page experience instead of opening the floating popup.
  • Dragging: Internal media moves no longer trigger the file-upload drop overlay.
  • Long images: Attachment preview modes reset to the top-left of the real image surface so tall screenshots can be inspected from the top.

v1.3.76 Dev

  • Media icons: Media Studio is back on scoped duotone Phosphor-style icons, while the rest of MV keeps its existing icon language.
  • Masonry: The former Bento view is now presented as Masonry, with old Bento preferences mapped forward for compatibility.
  • Filter: Removed the stray dropdown caret from the icon-only Media Studio Filter button.
  • Modules: Disabled modules are now blocked from shortcut keys, speed-dial actions, global toggle events, Mimam’s Bar shortcut/toggle listeners, and the Bricks media-picker bridge.
  • Media Library: Added opt-in settings to replace the native WordPress Media Library page with Media Studio and to auto-sync detected external folders when Media Studio opens.
  • Collections: Removing an MV collection now uses a branded confirmation dialog before any membership assignments are removed.
  • External folders: Added a refresh event path for deeper folder-plugin sync without forcing migration or taking ownership from the old plugin.

v1.3.75 Dev

  • Media icons: Media Studio now trials a scoped stroke-style Phosphor renderer while the rest of MV keeps its existing icon language.
  • Selection: Direct checkbox-to-checkbox Shift selection uses an explicit range path, so it no longer depends on browser checkbox change events preserving Shift.
  • Bento: Bento now uses real media sources and dimension-based card heights so natural proportions are visible instead of square-cropped thumbnails.
  • Long images: Attachment Fit width, Actual size, and Pan/zoom now use a taller scrollable preview surface and enlarge the real image instead of the clipped fit preview.
  • View chooser: Grid, Bento, and List choices now stay reachable when moving from the view button into the flyout.
  • Modules: Admin and Builder module toggles are independent once surface settings exist; old global disables are treated as a fallback only.
  • Docs: The complete guide now documents Media Studio behavior, per-surface module activation, and where roadmap research notes live.

v1.3.74 Dev

  • Media icons: Media Studio now renders self-contained filled Phosphor-style icons so controls do not disappear when an icon package or font fails to load.
  • Selection: Checkbox-to-checkbox Shift selection now preserves the Shift state from the checkbox itself, not only from card clicks.
  • Bento: Bento view now uses a masonry column layout with natural media proportions instead of square grid behavior.
  • Long images: Attachment Pan/zoom now zooms the real image and supports drag-to-pan inside the preview surface.
  • Sidebar: Media Studio collection scrolling is restored so only the collection tree scrolls while tools and bottom cards remain fixed.
  • Modules: Module visibility can now be controlled separately for Admin and Builder surfaces, e.g. CSS Studio can stay active in Builder while hidden in Admin.
  • Roadmap: Added Instatic and Bricks common-panel research notes to the product roadmap for future module, media, command, and panel architecture work.

v1.3.73 Dev

  • Selection: Media checkbox-to-checkbox Shift selection now preserves Shift through direct checkbox pointer/click events.
  • Preview: Removed the floating large hover preview. Attachment Details is now the reliable preview surface.
  • Bento: Bento view now uses dense aspect-ratio masonry instead of square grid behavior.
  • List metadata: List view fills the available width and scrolls horizontally when chosen metadata columns need more room.
  • Icons: Media Studio has moved back from the Iconsax trial to filled Phosphor icons, scoped only to Media Studio.
  • Sidebar: Only the collection tree scrolls; collection tools and bottom action cards stay fixed.
  • Long images: Pan/zoom now enlarges the real image inside the scrollable preview area.

v1.3.72 Dev

  • Filter: Media Studio Filter is now an icon-only control. Its popover keeps search, active-rule display, counts, Delete filter, and closes when clicking outside.
  • Selection: Checkbox-to-checkbox Shift selection was tightened through the shared checkbox path.
  • Preview: Larger hover preview now uses a safer gallery-bounded placement layer and hides instead of clipping when there is no usable safe zone.
  • List metadata: List view now has a metadata column chooser for MIME type, file size, dimensions, uploaded on, and uploaded by.
  • Long images: Attachment previews now support Fit, Fit width, Actual size, and Pan/zoom modes for screenshots and tall images.
  • Icons: Media Studio is now using the scoped Iconsax-style adapter as a broader design trial.
